description: Get metadata for one e-Stat Statistics Dashboard region code (name, level, valid date range), or omit region_code to fetch the full region catalog — Japan, its 47 prefectures and municipalities, plus world countries used for international-comparison indicators. Use this to discover region codes for estat-japan-dashboard.get_data. Data: dashboard.e-stat.go.jp, no auth required.

region_code.description: Region code to look up, e.g. '13000' (Tokyo) or '00000' (Japan). Omit to fetch the full region catalog (Japan + prefectures + municipalities + world countries) so you can discover valid codes for estat-japan-dashboard.get_data.
